description: Reviewed pins and human restore guidance, not an installation hook. Agents must not execute restoration.

powershell.prerequisites: Existing PowerShellGet Save-Module, official PSGallery registration and NuGet provider >=2.8.5.201. IT supplies missing prerequisites; never bootstrap NuGet or change policy.

python.debug: Select the existing .venv interpreter and install the approved Python Debugger VS Code extension yourself. No pip/debugpy installation or uv sync on F5.

java.debug: Set JAVA_HOME to the approved JDK 25, explicitly restore/test, then use the Java Test Runner/Debugger supplied by the recommended Java extension pack. Auto-build/update is disabled; no restoration on F5.

containers.guidance: Use Restore project dependencies, select ContainerImages then the sample and already-approved runtime. All builds only the three modern images; Legacy is explicit opt-in. RunContainer requires the existing local image and uses --pull=never; no build or pull during Run.

go.debug: IT/user must explicitly arrange the Go extension's approved Delve (dlv) tool before F5. Auto-update is disabled; GOTOOLCHAIN=local and GOPROXY=off prevent hidden downloads.
